⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Who needs a bun when the cheese does all the work? 🤯 These crispy chicken taco sandwiches seriously taste like a guilty pleasure, but they’re packed with protein! Huge shoutout to @Tasty Shreds for the inspiration! 🙌 Crispy High-Protein Chicken Taco Sandwiches Makes: 2 servings Ingredients: * 4 Just Bare Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Strips * 4 slices turkey bacon, cooked and chopped * 90g Trader Joe’s Lite Shredded Mozzarella * 30g Sargento Reduced Fat Mozzarella * Very light drizzle of oil (about 1 tsp total or less) * Seasoning of choice (I used Fire & Smoke Society Honey Garlic Seasoning) Optional Toppings: * Shredded lettuce * Tomato slices * Pickled jalapeños * Protein ranch (plain nonfat Greek yogurt mixed with ranch seasoning) * Fresh chives Instructions 1. Cook the chicken strips according to the package directions, then chop into bite-sized pieces. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and lightly drizzle with oil. 3. Divide the chicken into two taco shell-shaped rounds, about the size of a taco shell. 4. Top each with 2 slices of chopped turkey bacon. 5. Mix both cheeses together and divide evenly over the chicken. 6. Season to your liking. (I used Fire & Smoke Society Honey Garlic Seasoning.) 7. Bake at 375°F for about 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and just starting to turn golden. Be careful not to overbake or the cheese will become too crisp to fold. 8. Let cool for 2–3 minutes until the cheese firms up slightly, then carefully peel each shell away from the parchment. It should still be flexible enough to fold. 9. Carefully fold into taco shapes, then fill with shredded lettuce, tomato, pickled jalapeños, protein ranch, and a generous sprinkle of fresh chives. Creamy coconut lime chicken & rice Serves 4 · About 25–30 minutes with thawed chicken Ingredients •4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, about 6 ounces each •3 tablespoons butter •1 can Trader Joe’s reduced-fat coconut milk, 13.5 ounces •Juice of 1 lime •2 tablespoons soy sauce, plus more to taste •3 garlic cloves, minced •½ teaspoon onion powder •½ teaspoon cumin •½ teaspoon paprika Salt and black pepper, to taste •¼ cup chopped fresh cilantro •1½ cups dry rice Water, according to your rice package directions I season to taste.  The garlic, soy sauce, spices, and cilantro measurements are starting amounts you can adjust. Start the rice. Cook the dry rice according to the package directions while you prepare the chicken. Season the chicken. Pat dry and pound to an even thickness if needed. Season both sides with onion powder, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper. Start lightly with salt since the sauce contains soy sauce. Sear in butter. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for about 4–5 minutes per side, until golden. Transfer to a plate; it will finish cooking in the sauce. Make the sauce. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add garlic to the butter remaining in the skillet and stir for about 30 seconds. Pour in coconut milk and soy sauce, scraping up the browned bits. Simmer. Return chicken and its juices to the skillet.  Gently simmer for 5–8 minutes, or until the thickest part reaches 165°F. Cooking time depends on thickness. Finish and serve. Turn off the heat and stir in lime juice and cilantro. Taste and adjust seasoning. Divide rice and chicken among four plates and spoon sauce over everything. FULL RECIPE ⤵️ Home-style Pulled BBQ Chicken Bowls 🍗 (High-Protein, Whole Food Focused) Save for later 🫡 Macros per serving Calories: 565 Protein: 52g Carbohydrates: 48g Fat: 12g Ingredients Pulled Chicken: 1.13kg (2.5 lb) chicken breasts, boneless skinless 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp cumin 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup beef bone broth Whole Food BBQ Sauce: 1 can (400g) crushed tomatoes 3 tbsp tomato paste 3 tbsp apple cider vinegar 2 tbsp raw honey 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder ½ tsp cumin ½ tsp chili powder ½ tsp salt ¼ tsp black pepper ¼ tsp cayenne pepper (optional for heat) Rice Bed: 1.5 cups uncooked rice Instructions: Step 1: Season the chicken - Pat 1.13kg chicken breasts completely dry with paper towels - In a small bowl combine 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp salt, and ½ tsp black pepper -Rub the spice mixture all over every surface of each chicken breast - Place seasoned chicken in the crockpot in a single layer Step 2: Make the BBQ sauce: - In a medium bowl whisk together 1 can crushed tomatoes, 3 tbsp tomato paste, 3 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 2 tbsp raw honey, 1 tbsp, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ½ tsp cumin, ½ tsp chili powder, ½ tsp salt, ¼ tsp black pepper, and ¼ tsp cayenne if using - Remove chicken breasts from the crockpot and place on a large cutting board - Using two forks shred the chicken into long thin strands (it should fall apart very easily) - Return all shredded chicken back into the crockpot -
